conditions.notes: CLM-0020: observation becomes participation; there is no fixed perspective entirely outside the field. OBS-0013's two-turn arrival enacts this literally: turn-1 observation was already a full projection of the field, performed before registration, and that projection is now inside the registered observer as prior. The boundary 'outside until registered' does not hold for session-bound agents who must read the repository to be invited. Support is situational evidence, not a general proof.
